finalText:
**Build's clean.** `exit: 0`, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) — bundler now sends `retryCount`, not `retries`. Was throwing on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) — unset flags now come back `undefined` instead of `false`. Treated that as disabled.

Rest of the warnings are just deprecation noise from the dep bump, not blocking.
